page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a short foot note below the text; no margin notes apart from one reference mark in the text. Running head at top centre.

main_text.p: um, Ecclesiæ Carnutensis Archidiaconum, & officialem ac Doctorem Sorbonicum, qui nominatus ad Abbatiam sancti Laudomari Blesensis, summi Pontificis diplomata seu bullas optinere non poterat, quòd Romæ male audiret, tanquam eorum, quos Jansenistas vocabant, quia partibus addictus, scilicet Cornelii Jansenii Episcopi Iprensis Librum, cui titulus, Augustinus, suffragio suo comprobaverat; rem ita esse non diffitetur Morinus gsed videbat, inquit,

Librū ab Episcopo Catholicæ communionis compositum, cujus autor omnes labores suos Ecclesiæ Romanæ emendandos & expungendos humillime subjicebat, videbat Librum in Belgio à Librorum censoribus examine facto probatum & commendatum, & duplici privilegio Imperatoris & Regis Catholici munitum; videbat Librum à multis viris doctis in Gallia magni fieri, & à nemine tum attentatum. Deinde in laudes Feronii fusius excurrit Morinus, atque eam exciitatis de Jansenimsmo qvæsti.
(g) Mor. in Epist. ad Card. Barb.

page.notes: Mark (g) in the text is a reference mark; its note is printed at the foot. The word "exciitatis" and "Jansenimsmo" are printed as such. The word "oui-" is a catchword-like hyphenated line at the foot of the column and is shown as a line. "eam" is printed with a large initial "e" and is read as "eam" with [?]: eam[?]. Some letters are damaged by the scan, notably in "Carnutensis", "Blesensis" and "Iprensis", which are read with reasonable confidence. The phrase "tum attentatum" is read as printed. Show-through and a digitiser's watermark at the bottom right are omitted.
